name: 5-Sterne-Camping Zugspitz Resort
beschreibung: The 5-Star Camping Zugspitz Resort is located in **Ehrwald**, right at the foot of the **Zugspitze**, just steps away from the valley station of the **Tiroler Zugspitzbahn**. Open year-round, the site offers pitches for motorhomes and caravans as well as rental accommodations such as mobile homes and chalets. Facilities include a wellness area with an indoor pool and sauna, multiple dining options, and a wide range of leisure activities for children. The Zugspitzarena, featuring hiking and skiing trails, is directly accessible from the campsite. A highlight is the Naturbadesee (natural swimming lake) on the premises, inviting guests to swim in the summer. Visitors can enjoy a high-end infrastructure with electricity and fresh water at every pitch, along with modern sanitary facilities.
